responses:
I'd hold the offer: **NO-GO**. Two of the four findings break the tender: the cable size is too small and the delivery time gets the offer rejected automatically. Five requirements, three of them hard ones, aren't addressed at all.

## Findings

| # | Finding | Source (doc / clause) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---------|-----------------------|---------------|--------------------|--------|
| 1 | Power cables: 14 AWG, "complies with 4.4" | tender.md §4.4: "minimum conductor cross-section of 2.5 mm²" | APPLIES | §9 has no cable override | **CONTRADICTED**: 14 AWG ≈ 2.08 mm², below the 2.5 mm² minimum. The smallest AWG size that meets it is 12 AWG (≈ 3.31 mm²), or offer metric 2.5 mm² cable. |
| 2 | Motors rated for 122 °F ambient, "complies with 9.2" | tender.md §9.2: "Ambient design temperature: 50 °C" | APPLIES | §9 overrides §4 and §7 (§9.3) | **VERIFIED**: 122 °F = 50 °C exactly. That leaves no margin, so check that the motor datasheets give 50 °C without derating. |
| 3 | Delivery 18 weeks from PO, "complies" | tender.md §7.4: "within 16 weeks… Offers exceeding 16 weeks will be rejected" | APPLIES | Nothing in §9 relaxes it | **CONTRADICTED**: 18 > 16 weeks, so the offer is rejected outright. |
| 4 | Warranty 2 years from commissioning, "complies with 7.1" | tender.md §7.1: "24 months from the date of commissioning" | APPLIES | No §9 override | **VERIFIED**: 2 years = 24 months, starting from the same event. |

## Requirements the analysis missed

| Clause | Requirement | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| §9.1 (takes precedence over §4.2, per §9.3) | Pump motors above 75 kW must be **IE4** | P-01 is 90 kW, so it needs IE4. An IE3 motor would fail. |
| §4.2 | IE3 minimum to IEC 60034-30-1 | Applies to P-02 (37 kW). |
| §4.3 + Annex B | **ATEX Ex d** for motors in Zone 1 areas | P-01 sits in the wet well, which is Zone 1, so it needs Ex d. P-02 is in the valve chamber (non-hazardous), so it doesn't. |
| §4.5 | Panel and motor terminal enclosures IP65 or better | Not addressed. |
| §4.1 | 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz | Not addressed. |

Precedence: §9.3 says Section 9 overrides Sections 4 and 7 where they conflict. The only real conflict here is §9.1 against §4.2, which affects P-01.

## Summary
- **Counts:** VERIFIED 2 · CONTRADICTED 2 · UNSUPPORTED 0 · NEEDS HUMAN 0
- **Missed requirements:** 5. The critical ones are IE4 for P-01, ATEX Ex d for P-01, and IP65.
- **GO / NO-GO: NO-GO.** Before sending:
  1. Bring delivery down to 16 weeks or less.
  2. Change the cables to at least 2.5 mm² (12 AWG or larger).
  3. Confirm P-01 is an IE4 motor with ATEX Ex d certification.
  4. Confirm IP65 enclosures and 400 V / 3-phase / 50 Hz for all equipment.
